requirements.reason: Provider auth_time is the only accepted source-owned recent-auth authority.
The five-minute WS03-03A threshold and exact boundary behavior need controlled evidence after plan approval.
Recent-auth denial must use the stable safe public error envelope.
Recent-auth wrappers must preserve accepted identity, account-state, verified-email, and admin authority.
Current high-risk account/admin/terminal-lifecycle/financial-repair/notice/saved-card routes must require recent auth.
Intentionally ungated and retired/non-executing routes must remain classified, and high-risk routes must not become silent bypasses.
Frontend password and Google step-up must use Firebase reauth safely and fail closed.
Step-up retry must remain caller-owned with no blind global mutation replay.
Credential linking requires step-up and remains provider-owned without local relink authority.
Freshness must not be persisted, mirrored, logged, or accepted as app-owned authority.
Negative-space inventory must fail closed for bypasses, admin mutation partition drift, route-family misclassification, and false provider/governance closure.
Administrator MFA provider/governance evidence cannot be closed by local WS03-03A pytest and must have zero pytest mappings.
Firebase App Check provider/runtime evidence cannot be closed by local WS03-03A pytest and must have zero pytest mappings.
Firebase/GCP credential governance cannot be closed by local WS03-03A pytest and must have zero pytest mappings.
